title: Law Enforcement Officers Killed and Assaulted (LEOKA)
description: This collection provides data on officers feloniously or accidentally killed and officers that were assaulted while performing their duties.

contactPoint.fn: Criminal Justice Information Services Division Federal Bureau of Investigation (USDOJ)

keyword: law enforcement officers killed and assaulted

distribution.description: Web form to submit requests for earlier Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) data that is not available in the FBI Crime Data Explorer (CDE) or FBI.gov archive. Requests for LEOKA data can be submitted for data for years 1972 to 1995.
distribution.title: 1972 to 1995: By Request

distribution.description: Historical Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) publications are maintained in an archive on FBI.gov. The FBI.gov archive provides LEOKA data for years 1996 to 2019.
distribution.title: 1996 to 2019: FBI.gov archive

distribution.description: The Crime Data Explorer (CDE) offers downloadable Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) data files. The CDE provides LEOKA Annual Reports for years 2020 to present.
distribution.title: 2020 to Present: Crime Data Explorer
